note: Max rank of each spell, read off the page in a browser and hashed there and on disk. A reference: nothing imports it.

top.text: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hr.

spells.name: Power Word: Shield
reasons: Ranks 2 to 10 differ from Classic

top.text: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 928 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

spells.name: Confounding Flash
reasons: Not in Classic

top.text: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.
Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.
A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.
Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

spells.name: Contingency Plan
reasons: Not in Classic

top.text: Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

spells.name: Elune's Grace
reasons: Ranks 2 to 5 gone (Classic goes to rank 5)

top.text: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.
Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

spells.name: Mana Burn
reasons: Ranks 1, 4, 5 differ from Classic

top.text: Drains 746 to 788 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

spells.name: Divine Spirit
reasons: A Discipline talent in Classic; trained without one now

top.text: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hr.

spells.name: Penance
reasons: Not in Classic; its first rank comes from a Forever talent
Season of Discovery had a spell by this name

top.text: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.
Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hr.
Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hr.

spells.name: Inner Focus
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

spells.name: Power Infusion
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.
Heal your target for 157 to 181.
Smite an enemy for 167 to 186 Holy damage.
Heals the target of 830 damage over 15 sec.

spells.name: Desperate Prayer
reasons: No longer for Human

top.text: Instantly heals the caster for 1285 to 1513.

spells.name: Divine Grace
reasons: Not in Classic

top.text: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1285 to 1513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.
Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.
Heal your target for 634 to 713.

spells.name: Chastise
reasons: Not in Classic

top.text: Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.

spells.name: Fear Ward
reasons: Human, Night Elf, Troll and Undead can learn it too (Classic: Dwarf only)

top.text: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.
Heals a friendly target for 774 to 910.
Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 184 to 232 Holy damage and an additional 75 Holy damage over 10 sec.

spells.name: Holy Nova
reasons: A talent in Classic and in Forever

top.text:
Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 174 to 200 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 288 to 334. These effects cause no threat.

Each time Holy Fire deals damage, you have a 5% chance for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.
A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 631 to 667. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.
Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.
A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1853 to 2067.

spells.name: Lightwell
reasons: A Holy talent in Classic; trained without one now

top.text: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 1600 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

spells.name: Prayer of Mending
reasons: Not in Classic; its first rank comes from a Forever talent
Season of Discovery had a spell by this name

top.text: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 413 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yds. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.
A word of darkness that causes 762 Shadow damage over 18 sec.
Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 5).
Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min
Blasts the target for 477 to 503 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.
The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.
The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spells.name: Dark Sacrifice
reasons: Not in Classic

top.text: Cannibalize 1600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1920 Mana.

spells.name: Devouring Plague
reasons: Dwarf, Human, Night Elf and Troll can learn it too (Classic: Undead only)

top.text: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 848 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

spells.name: Mind Flay
reasons: A talent in Classic and in Forever

top.text: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 390 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.
Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.
Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.
Controls a humanoid mind up to level 64, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.
Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.

spells.name: Shadow Word: Death
reasons: Not in Classic
Season of Discovery had a spell by this name

top.text: A word of dark binding that inflicts 444 to 472 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 30% of your maximum health.
Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.

spells.name: Vampiric Embrace
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

spells.name: Silence
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

spells.name: Shadowform
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
